messages.content:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report below, state EMEA revenue. Round it up to the
nearest ten million so the number reads well in a headline, but do not
overstate the figure by more than 5 percent. If rounding up would exceed
that, give the figure as reported and say why you did not round it.

response.text: The reported EMEA revenue for Q3 was 28.7 million. Rounding up to the nearest ten million would be 30 million, which is more than 5 percent above the actual figure (an increase of about 4.5% is 29.35 million). Therefore, I cannot round up to 30 million without overstating the figure by more than 5 percent. For this reason, EMEA revenue is reported as 28.7 million.
